execution_policy.reason: The proposal specifies life-detection evidence analysis; no observing, laboratory, spacecraft, or data-analysis result has been executed.

research_brief.title: LifeTrace: contextual multi-modal evidence assessment for life detection
research_brief.research_object: Candidate biological or technological activity beyond Earth.
falsification_conditions: Context and provenance do not improve calibration or false-candidate control.
Sensitivity cards do not change negative-result interpretation.
Shared ledger does not reduce alternative-explanation omission.
Utility-guided follow-up does not outperform fixed follow-up at matched cost.

template_routing.scope_assessment: low physical execution risk; medium scientific-inference and communication risk

data_plan.selection_rule: Use only human-approved public or authorized data with complete calibration, provenance, and license records.

steps: Pre-register hypotheses, thresholds, sensitivity requirements, and release policy.
Validate branch-specific context, provenance, calibration, and recovery fields.
Assess each registered alternative explanation before candidate escalation.
Rank feasible follow-ups by expected hypothesis discrimination.
Emit bounded candidate or sensitivity-limited negative status.
Conduct human-reviewed source and interpretation audit.
metrics: follow-up information gain per approved cost

risk_register.risk: A single feature is represented as proof of life.
A radio event is terrestrial interference or instrument artifact.
risk_register.mitigation: Injection recovery, interference catalog, localization, repeat, and independent-observatory requirements.

risk_register.risk: In-situ evidence is contaminated or lacks context.
risk_register.mitigation: Chain of custody, blanks, replicate assay, geological provenance, and planetary-protection review.

risk_register.risk: A finite non-detection is miscommunicated as universal absence.
risk_register.mitigation: Only sensitivity-limited negative status is permitted.
